blocks.text: Zimmedarana aur munsifana technology banane ke liye mukhtalif shobon ke maahireen ka mil kar kaam karna zaroori hai. Qanooni maahireen qawaid ki pabandi yaqeeni banate hain, sociologists (samajiyat ke maahireen) technology ka samaji asar parhte hain, aur ethicists (akhlaqiyat ke maahireen) akhlaqi faislon ki rehnumai karte hain. Mil kar yeh maahireen aise mutawazin hal banate hain jo logon ki hifazat bhi karein aur nayi ijaad ko bhi aage barhayein.

Technology ke hal un logon ke tanawwo ki numaindagi karein jin ki woh khidmat karte hain. Zaban, saqafat aur rasai (accessibility) ke farq ka khayal rakh kar developers aise systems bana sakte hain jo sirf chand logon ke liye nahi, sab ke liye kaam karein. Mukhtalif shobon ka ishtirak nayi ijaad ko sab ko shamil karne wala, munsifana aur paidar rakhta hai, aur aisi technology ki raah banata hai jo waqai muashre ko faida de.

blocks.caption: Kaun kya karta hai?
rows: Technology ke samaji asar ka mutala

blocks.prompt: Zimmedar technology banane mein legal experts, sociologists aur ethicists ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation: Legal experts qawaneen ki pabandi yaqeeni banate hain, sociologists technology ke samaji asar ka mutala karte hain, aur ethicists akhlaqi faislon mein rehnumai karte hain. Mil kar woh aise hal banate hain jo logon ko bachayein aur nayi ijaad bhi chalti rahe.

blocks.prompt: Poore section 8.4 ka jaiza: Hospital ke AI project ko programmers ke saath qanooni maahir aur akhlaqiyat ka maahir kyun chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Qanooni maahir yaqeeni banata hai ke mareezon ka data data-protection qanoon aur ijazat ke saath jama aur mehfooz ho; akhlaqiyat ka maahir dekhta hai ke system tamam mareezon se munsifana sulook kare, us ke faisle samjhaye ja sakein, aur ghalti par kaun zimmedar ho. Akele programmers durusti par tawajjuh de kar yeh khatre nazar-andaz kar sakte hain.

items: Interdisciplinary collaboration: mukhtalif shobon ke mahir mil kar.
Zaban, saqafat aur accessibility ka khayal: technology sab ke liye.
